context.transcript:
Did the furniture shipment go out this morning?
A. A one-week sale.
B. It looks nice in this room.
C. Shipments are always in the afternoon.
context.transcript_translation:
家具的货运今天早上发了吗？
A. 一周的促销。
B. 它在这个房间里看起来不错。
C. 货物总是下午发。

choices: It looks nice in this room.

items.question: Did the furniture shipment go out this morning?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Did the furniture shipment go out this morning?”，自然应答是“Shipments are always in the afternoon.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（Shipments are always in the afternoon.）。
